inventory.description: One continuous transverse wave trace, starting at the horizontal equilibrium line, rising rightward to one crest, crossing the equilibrium line once internally, descending to one trough, then rising rightward back to equilibrium at the right end. One complete cycle, two endpoint equilibrium contacts and one interior equilibrium crossing. Crest is left of trough. No numerical amplitude, wavelength, period, coordinate, particle dots or tick marks.

One shared approximately horizontal equilibrium/reference line extends well left of the wave and through it to the right endpoint. Its far-left end has a left-pointing arrowhead: propagation is leftward. The line and wave share their equilibrium contacts. There is no rightward propagation arrowhead.

One vertical two-headed vibration arrow at the wave crest's horizontal position, crossing the equilibrium/reference line. Its upper head points up toward the crest and its lower head points down below equilibrium. Vibration is perpendicular to propagation. Total visible directional arrowheads in this source: three, comprising one propagation head and two vibration heads.

labels.relation: Above the leftward horizontal propagation line, left of the wave.
Above the crest and vertical vibration arrow.

figures.modernizationBoundary: A sampled deterministic approximation and translation to English may be modern additions. The original is one continuous wave trace; its source object count is not a count of rendering segments.

inventory.description: One long approximately horizontal line spans the source. Both vibration and propagation direction indicators lie on this same line. One right-pointing propagation arrowhead at the far-right end of the long shared line. Total visible directional arrowheads: three, two for vibration plus one for propagation.
